name: Homeboyz Entertainment Plc
source: NSE announcement of audited results FY2023, summary statement of cash flow, Homeboyz Entertainment Plc
source_note: Audited summary statement of cash flow for the year ended 31 December 2023 with the 31 December 2022 comparative as printed, Kshs. Operating plus investing plus financing reproduces the printed change in cash and cash equivalents in both years. The summary prints investing and financing only as net subtotals, so Capital Expenditure and Free Cash Flow are left blank rather than inferred.
